name: Effect button
for: The one primary call to action: on hover and focus a slow effect fades into its fill; a secondary button can carry the effect in its border instead.
how: An effect host inside the button (fill) or a cx-ring host around it (border), in a palette within a few steps of the accent; the fill is centred (calm 0, low scatter, a soft radial mask) and low in contrast. Mounted paused, it runs only while pointed at or focused.
rules: Only the primary call to action, or one button pair, per page.
The label keeps 4.5:1 on every frame of the fill.
The fill is even across the button: no bright patch at one end.
Nothing moves until hover or focus.
Demo notes ('hover to see it') belong to the showcase, never to the component markup.
a11y: A real link with its own text; the effect host is aria-hidden. Keyboard focus lights it as hover does. Reduced motion shows a still frame.
